title: Cosmos DB Overview
text: Azure Cosmos DB is a globally distributed, multi-model database service. Through its Core API it provides a query language with SQL like syntax over schemaless documents. Cosmos DB provides five consistency levels: Strong, Bounded Staleness, Session, Consistent Prefix, and Eventual.

title: Vector Search in Cosmos DB
text: Azure Cosmos DB supports vector indexing for semantic similarity search. The VectorDistance function calculates similarity between a stored embedding and a query embedding, and DiskANN indexes accelerate nearest-neighbor lookups across large vector collections.

title: Partitioning and Data Modeling
text: Effective data modeling in Cosmos DB starts with choosing a partition key that distributes load evenly. Hierarchical (composite) partition keys help avoid hot partitions, and denormalized documents minimize cross-partition queries for read-heavy workloads.

title: Request Units (RU/s)
text: Throughput in Cosmos DB is measured in Request Units per second (RU/s). Every read, write, and query consumes RUs based on document size, indexing, and query complexity. Provisioned, autoscale, and serverless are the three throughput modes available.

title: Change Feed
text: The Cosmos DB change feed exposes an ordered stream of inserts and updates per partition. It powers event-driven architectures, materialized views, and downstream synchronization with services like Azure Functions, Synapse Link, and Microsoft Fabric mirroring.
